queries.q: ghost videos with insane plot twist
queries.criteria: A serious ghost story with an actual major narrative reveal. Fictional and supposedly real stories are both eligible. Funny sketches, horror-comedy and parody are unrelated. Generic scary clips and clickbait twist claims are weak matches.
The actual identity reveal scene from Fight Club; distinguish the scene from reviews, recaps and unrelated fights.

queries.q: underrated github repos to earn money
queries.criteria: Usable GitHub repositories with a concrete plausible way to build a paid product or service. No guaranteed-income claims; inspect license and maintenance separately.
WWE clips with clearly excited or shocked commentator reactions, preferably with exact moments. Crowd-only reactions and generic match highlights are weaker.

grading: Human review only: 0 unrelated, 1 weak or partial, 2 relevant, 3 strong exact match. Leave null if not reviewed. Assess observed content, not model score or site fame.
